name: CubeBrowser
author: Arial-Bold
description_short: A real web browser for the GameCube with HTTPS, images, CSS, forms, SD card downloads and a MIDI music player
description_long: CubeBrowser loads websites over a wired network connection, including HTTPS sites, with pictures, page styles, tables and forms. It has its own layout engine, cookies for classic logins, bookmarks, resumable multi-connection downloads straight to the SD card with zip extraction, a background MIDI player with SoundFont support, and built-in updaters for itself and Swiss. No JavaScript support.

license.notes: The upstream repository has no LICENSE file and the README does not state a license.
